# Button

> Accessible action button with size, variant, and semantic tone support.

This file matches the installed `button` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/button.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/button.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/button-knobs`: `buttonKnobs`, types `ButtonKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/button`: `ButtonTrackContext`, `buttonShapes`, `buttonLayouts`, `buttonStructureClasses`, `buttonTrackStructureClasses`, `buttonContentClasses`, `Button`, `ButtonLink`, `ButtonLabel`, types `ButtonVariant`, `ButtonSize`, `ButtonTone`, `ButtonShape`, `ButtonLayout`, `ButtonAppearanceProps`, `ButtonProps`, `ButtonLinkProps`, `ButtonLabelProps`

## Composition

### Action button

```tsx
<Button>
  button content
</Button>
```

### Navigation link

```tsx
<ButtonLink>
  link content
</ButtonLink>
```

### Label-backed control

```tsx
<ButtonLabel>
  label content
</ButtonLabel>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { ArrowUpRightIcon, CheckIcon, DownloadIcon, MonitorIcon, PlayIcon, PlusIcon, SmartphoneIcon } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Button, ButtonLink } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

function Row({ label, children }: { label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Text size="caption" weight="medium" tone="muted">
        {label}
      </Text>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function PrimitiveButtonExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-5 p-2">
      <Row label="Variant">
        <Button variant="solid">Solid</Button>
        <Button variant="surface">Surface</Button>
        <Button variant="ghost">Ghost</Button>
        <Button variant="quiet">Quiet</Button>
        <Button variant="dashed">
          <PlusIcon />
          Dashed
        </Button>
        <Button variant="link">Link</Button>
      </Row>
      <Row label="Over media">
        <div className="relative w-72 max-w-full">
          <img
            src="/dynamic-notification/sequoia-sunrise.png"
            alt="Sequoia grove at sunrise"
            className="aspect-video w-full rounded-[var(--radius-lg)] object-cover"
          />
          <div className="absolute inset-x-2 bottom-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <Button variant="scrim">
              <PlayIcon />
              Play
            </Button>
            <Button variant="scrim" iconOnly aria-label="Download photo">
              <DownloadIcon />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Row>
      <Row label="Tone">
        <Button variant="solid" tone="primary">
          Primary
        </Button>
        <Button variant="solid" tone="danger">
          Danger
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" tone="primary">
          Primary
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" tone="danger">
          Danger
        </Button>
      </Row>
      <Row label="Size">
        <Button variant="surface" size="xs">
          Extra small
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" size="sm">
          Small
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" size="md">
          Medium
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" size="lg">
          Large
        </Button>
      </Row>
      <Row label="Icon only">
        <Button variant="surface" size="xs" iconOnly aria-label="Extra small icon button">
          <PlusIcon />
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" size="sm" iconOnly aria-label="Small icon button">
          <PlusIcon />
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" size="md" iconOnly aria-label="Medium icon button">
          <PlusIcon />
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" size="lg" iconOnly aria-label="Large icon button">
          <PlusIcon />
        </Button>
      </Row>
      <Row label="State">
        <Button variant="quiet" active aria-pressed>
          Active
        </Button>
        <Button variant="solid" disabled>
          Disabled
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface">
          <CheckIcon />
          With icon
        </Button>
      </Row>
      <Row label="Tile">
        <Button variant="surface" layout="tile" aria-pressed={false}>
          <MonitorIcon />
          Desktop
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" layout="tile" active aria-pressed>
          <SmartphoneIcon />
          Mobile
        </Button>
      </Row>
      <Row label="Link">
        <ButtonLink href="#preview" variant="ghost">
          Render as link
          <ArrowUpRightIcon />
        </ButtonLink>
      </Row>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### button

- `--cui-button-press-background`: `var(--cui-button-hover-background)`
- `--cui-button-press-scale`: `0.96`
- `--cui-button-hover-border-color`: `var(--cui-button-border-color)`
- `--cui-button-open-border-color`: `var(--cui-button-hover-border-color)`
- `--cui-button-open-background`: `var(--cui-button-hover-background)`
- `--cui-button-open-foreground`: `var(--cui-button-hover-foreground)`
- `--cui-button-open-shadow`: `var(--cui-button-shadow)`
- `--cui-button-hover-background-image`: `var(--cui-button-background-image)`
- `--cui-button-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)`
- `--cui-button-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-button-active-background`: `var(--active-fill)`
- `--cui-button-active-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-button-active-hover-background`: `var(--cui-button-active-background)`
- `--cui-button-hover-shadow`: `var(--cui-button-shadow)`
- `--cui-button-press-shadow`: `var(--cui-button-hover-shadow)`
- `--cui-button-active-shadow`: `var(--cui-button-shadow)`
- `--cui-button-radius`: `var(--nest-radius, var(--radius-control))`
- `--cui-button-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5)`
- `--cui-button-icon`: `1rem`
- `--cui-button-height`: `var(--control-h-md)`
- `--cui-button-padding-inline`: `var(--padding-x)`
- `--cui-button-padding-block`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5)`
- `--cui-button-icon-padding-inline`: `max(0px, calc(var(--cui-button-padding-inline) - var(--spacing) * 0.5))`
- `--cui-button-font-size`: `var(--text-body)`
- `--cui-button-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)`
- `--cui-button-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-button-background-image`: `none`
- `--cui-button-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-button-shadow`: `0 0 transparent`
- `--cui-button-border-width`: `0px`
- `--cui-button-border-style`: `solid`
- `--cui-button-border-color`: `var(--control-rim)`
- `--cui-button-backdrop-filter`: `none`
